messages:
sasha: Quick executive note: we're putting a docs + SDK baseline rule into effect: all public examples must specify model_pin and a runtime_weight default. This reduces surprise regressions when model variants shift. See rollout below.

leo: Is this a soft recommendation or enforced?

sasha: Start soft. Timeline: 2026-04-05 publish new examples + migration guide; 2026-04-12 SDK patch sets the examples' defaults in templates; 2026-05-02 telemetry starts emitting warnings for undocumented examples; 2026-05-30 enforcement: docs linter fails CI on missing pin in examples.

anya: Customers running on Dedicated/Private might want different guidance. Are we giving per-deployment notes?

sasha: yes. Migration guide will have three sections: Hosted (recommended pins we vet), Dedicated (how to pin to local variants), Private (ops checklist + legal notes).

docs-bot: Draft guide posted: https://go.redwood/internal/pin-guidance-v1 (internal). Snippet we recommend in examples: ```json
{
  "model_pin": "redwood/stable-2026-01",
  "runtime_weight": "balanced"
}
```

leo: Will this change our telemetry or billing? Could runtime_weight default bump cost?

sasha: runtime_weight defaults chosen for examples will be conservative/balanced to avoid cost spikes. We'll add a recommended mapping table in docs showing tradeoffs and expected unit-cost delta.

eng-bot: Note: we'll add a linter rule `RW_DOCS_PIN_REQUIRED` to the docs CI. It will be soft until 2026-05-30, then hard.

anya: We need templated language for CSMs explaining the ROI of pinning vs. quick fixes for apps that can't pin immediately.

sasha: @anya working with CSM team to draft. Also: a small CLI helper will be included in SDK: `rw pin-suggest` that proposes a pin based on last 72h traffic surface.

leo: Are there any legal/regulatory flags?

docs-bot: Legal sign-off status: Reviewed, no change to contracts required. We'll surface a short blurb for enterprise sales packs.

ceo: Thanks — important to call this out in next all-hands. Can we get a 2-slide exec brief?

sasha: yes. I'll drop slides to the deck by EOD.

leo: Who owns the linter and timeline?
sasha: @docs-bot owns doc updates + linter, @leo owns SDK helper and patch, @anya owns CSM copy and customer comms.

eng-bot: Ops note: if teams rely on `REDWOOD_MODEL` env var we'll log a deprecation hint for 30 days before changing SDK templates.

anya: Schedule a support checkbox: global customers must be notified 2 weeks before enforcement.

sasha: agreed. Notification window: starts 2026-05-16. CSMs will email major accounts with proposed pins.

leo: I'm adding a short automated report to the console showing examples without pins so we can track progress.

ceo: Good. Please add an item to the weekly product sync to review progress on 2026-04-20.

sasha: Will do. Thanks all. If you need to follow up, join the Q&A 2026-04-03 9:30 PT (calendar invite).
